title: Semantic Scholar (research)
description: Academic papers from Semantic Scholar as a research source on scientific and technical topics, declared as a service.
setup_notes: The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. Get a free API key at semanticscholar.org/product/api. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then add it under Admin > Extensions > Research Sources, which puts it to use: research asks it on the topics set there (suggested: scientific, medical, technology, environmental, economic, education), and a tool name there offers it to agents through query_source. Or pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as the engine.
